title: Agent & Chain Orchestration
summary: This module provides the core components for building intelligent agents and complex chains, enabling LLMs to reason, act, and interact with tools and external data sources.

nodes.label: Runnables
nodes.title: Runnables Module
nodes.description: Defines the foundational interface for composable units of work, enabling declarative chain construction and managing execution flow.

nodes.label: Agents
nodes.title: Agent Orchestration Module
nodes.description: Provides various agent implementations and utilities for building intelligent agents that can reason, act, and interact with tools and language models.

nodes.label: Chains
nodes.title: Chains Module
nodes.description: Offers a structured way to combine LLMs with other components, enabling complex sequences of operations for various NLP tasks like conversational AI, data extraction, and summarization.

nodes.label: Tools
nodes.title: Tools Module
nodes.description: Defines base classes and utilities for creating and managing tools that agents can use to interact with the world, including input parsing, execution, and error handling.

nodes.label: Language Model Interfaces
nodes.title: Language Model Interfaces
nodes.description: Provides the core interfaces for interacting with various language models (LLMs) and chat models.

nodes.label: Prompting & Parsing
nodes.title: Prompting and Parsing Module
nodes.description: Handles prompt template creation, management, and output parsing for LLMs.

nodes.label: Data Retrieval & Memory
nodes.title: Data Retrieval and Memory Module
nodes.description: Manages data retrieval mechanisms (like vector stores) and conversational memory for agents and chains.

nodes.label: Callbacks & Tracing
nodes.title: Callbacks and Tracing Module
nodes.description: Provides infrastructure for handling callbacks and tracing within the LangChain ecosystem, enabling detailed monitoring and interaction during execution.

nodes.label: Agent Middleware
nodes.title: Agent Middleware Module
nodes.description: A collection of middleware components designed to enhance and modify the behavior of agents, offering functionalities like tool call limits, PII detection, and summarization.

groups.label: Core Orchestration
groups.title: Core Orchestration Components
groups.description: These components form the backbone of intelligent applications, defining how LLMs interact with tools, data, and each other to achieve complex goals.

groups.label: Interaction Components
groups.title: Interaction and Enhancement Components
groups.description: These modules provide the means for agents to interact with the external world and enhance their behavior through various middleware functionalities.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Key External Dependencies
groups.description: These modules provide essential functionalities like LLM communication, prompt management, data access, and observability, which are critical for agents and chains.
